# Archon

> The official VEKN web application and API for Vampire: The Eternal Struggle (VTES) tournaments, decklists, leagues, members and ratings.

Archon is an offline-first PWA at https://archon.vekn.net/ for running VTES tournaments and managing VEKN membership. Third-party integrations use the Public API (read-only organizational data, Bearer token required) or the Member API (OAuth2 authorization code with PKCE, per-event access). Card data, rulings and rules live in the companion KRCG ecosystem below.

## API

- [API Reference](https://api.archon.vekn.net/docs): Interactive reference for both the Public API (read-only tournaments, decklists, leagues, members, ratings, community links, and full gzipped corpus export) and the Member API (OAuth2 login and per-tournament operations). Requires an Archon account with a VEKN ID and the DEV role to register an OAuth client.
- [OpenAPI Schema](https://api.archon.vekn.net/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification for the Public API and Member API.

## Official VTES Documents

- [Rulebook](https://archon.vekn.net/help/rules): Official V:TES game rules.
- [Tournament Rules](https://archon.vekn.net/help/tournament-rules): Official VEKN tournament rules.
- [Judges' Guide](https://archon.vekn.net/help/judges-guide): Official VEKN Judges' Guide.
- [Code of Ethics](https://archon.vekn.net/help/code-of-ethics): Official VEKN Code of Ethics.

## Companion VTES Data Ecosystem

- [Primogen MCP](https://mcp.krcg.org/mcp): Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol server for VTES cards, rulings, rules, deck analysis, meta statistics, and tournaments; see [KRCG llms.txt](https://mcp.krcg.org/llms.txt) for the full KRCG service index and [Primogen](https://github.com/lionel-panhaleux/primogen) for setup.
- [KRCG Static Resources](https://static.krcg.org/): Daily-refreshed card data ([vtes.json](https://static.krcg.org/data/vtes.json)), Tournament Winning Deck Archive ([twda.json](https://static.krcg.org/data/twda.json)), card images, icons, and fonts.
- [KRCG API](https://api.krcg.org/docs): Free, unauthenticated REST API for card search, rulings, TWDA queries, and decklist conversion; [OpenAPI schema](https://api.krcg.org/openapi.json).

## Optional

- [Archon Web App](https://archon.vekn.net/): Tournament organization, VEKN membership, rankings, and league management.
- [Source Repository](https://github.com/vtes-biased/archon-vibe): Open-source repository (MIT) and technical documentation.
- [VEKN](https://www.vekn.net/): Vampire: Elder Kindred Network, the international V:TES players' association.
